page_title: UDI 3-2 VEN | Udinese v Venezia 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Udinese is cautioned for aggressive play. A free kick to Venezia.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Thauvin.
90+2' It's like he was asking for a caution. Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia) receives a yellow card.
90+2' A yellow card is awarded to Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' John Yeboah (Venezia) is booked by the referee.
87' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Ridgeciano Haps will be replaced by Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).
86' The ball is out of play. Venezia win a corner kick.
84' 3 - 2 Goal! Oumar Solet shows great vision to find Iker Bravo (Udinese) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
83' A substitution has been made. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is replaced by Simone Pafundi (Udinese).
78' 2 - 2 Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) perfectly latches on to a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
78' Kike Perez (Venezia) will deliver the corner kick.
75' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
75' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Venezia have a free kick.
74' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
74' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) will take the corner.

73' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom left corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Filip Stankovic made a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
70' Handball! A player from Venezia handled the ball.
65' Substitution. Martin Payero makes way for Arthur Atta (Udinese).
65' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jordan Zemura (Udinese) replacing Hassane Kamara.
65' Substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) on for Alexis Sanchez.
64' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. The ball ends up inside the left post. Superb strike!
63' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes a direct free kick.
63' Udinese concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Venezia have a free kick.
62' The substitution has been made. Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) has replaced Gaetano Oristanio.
62' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Issa Doumbia and he is replaced by Kike Perez (Venezia).
62' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Gianluca Busio is replaced by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia).
56' Venezia earn a corner.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
51' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
51' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
50' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
50' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Udinese.
47' 1 - 0 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) meets a perfect cross from Hassane Kamara deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
47' Florian Thauvin swings in the free kick towards Jaka Bijol (Udinese), who powers a header high over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
46' It seemed like Florian Thauvin (Udinese) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
46' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Udinese have been awarded a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Venezia earn a free kick.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' That's unlucky! Sandi Lovric (Udinese) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
39' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia). Maurizio Mariani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Udinese win a free kick.
38' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Venezia.

36' A sweet pass finds John Yeboah (Venezia) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Razvan Sava is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
36' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
35' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

34' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Filip Stankovic was alert and the score remains the same. Now Udinese have a corner.

33' Martin Payero (Udinese) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
30' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
23' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make a change. Filip Stankovic is unable to continue due to injury, Jesse Joronen (Venezia) comes on.
18' It doesn’t look good for Filip Stankovic (Venezia); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
17' The game is interrupted now, Filip Stankovic (Venezia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

8' John Yeboah (Venezia) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
8' The ball goes out for a corner. Venezia can continue in their attacking effort.
7' The resulting set piece from Venezia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Venezia are going to take it.
5' The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
